Actress Ryu Hye-young revealed a chilling anecdote she experienced while filming a movie.

On the 19th, a video titled "Laple Weekly HOT & NEW" with the subtitle "Dopamine Addiction Survival Thriller Killing Time" was released on the YouTube channel 'LIFEPLUS TV'.

On this day, lead actors Ryu Hye-young and Nam Yoon-soo from the film "Killing Time" shared behind-the-scenes stories of the filming alongside MC Ahn Hyun-mo.

The two revealed that they filmed at an actual abandoned hospital. Ryu Hye-young confessed that although a separate waiting room had been prepared for the actors during filming, she barely used it due to the scary atmosphere. Nam Yoon-soo also explained that because there was no electricity in the abandoned hospital, all areas where filming lights were not installed were dark.

In particular, Ryu Hye-young drew attention by sharing stories from fellow actors who participated in the filming and claimed to have seen a ghost. It was reported that multiple actors claimed to have seen the figure of the same female ghost on different days at the same lodging.

Ryu Hye-young stated that she is not usually someone who sees ghosts, but she felt a chill down her spine after hearing the stories on set. She recalled that every time she returned to her lodging after finishing filming, she prayed to be able to fall asleep without seeing a ghost.

On the other hand, Nam Yoon-soo said he did not have any special horror experiences during filming and reported that he slept well at the lodging as well. However, he added that he had heard a story from a fellow actor who saw a ghost in the lodging just before filming.

Meanwhile, the film "Killing Time," starring Ryu Hye-young and Nam Yoon-soo, is a thriller depicting an internet broadcasting crew who visits an abandoned hospital to make a comeback and gets attacked by a mysterious presence. The film opens on the 21st.
